title: Keep postflop-ranges unit tests inside the coverage-run time limit
description: CI's 'Unit tests with coverage' job timed out (30 s testTimeout) on tests/advice/postflop-ranges.test.ts > 'actions mode is total, deterministic and falls back' twice in an hour: main run 45302242833 (d72e593, passed on re-run) and branch run 45306421540 (doit/TASK-2.6). Locally the test takes 1.7 s plain and 8.4 s under coverage; 'default advice stays on every unseen combo' takes 5.2 s under coverage. CI runners are slower, so the margin is gone. Fix the timing without dropping or loosening any assertion (e.g. a measured per-test timeout, moving the heavy case to the uncovered sweep job, or making the equity work cheaper).

nodes.title: Keep postflop-ranges unit tests inside the coverage-run time limit

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the unit tests with coverage run on a CI runner, When tests/advice/postflop-ranges.test.ts runs, Then every test finishes with at least 3x headroom under its timeout, shown by the measured duration in the CI log
Given the change, When the test file is compared with its previous version, Then no assertion is removed or loosened and the number of checked cases is unchanged
Given three consecutive CI runs on the story branch, When they finish, Then 'Unit tests with coverage' passes in all three
